subject: Reserved pool scale amendment for Orchid Analytics — proposal and next steps
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@orchid.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@orchid.ai
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Need to scale reserved pool for Q3 — 8→16 GPUs

Jonas,

Thanks again for the run-through last week. Our model tests over the POC week showed a consistent 30% fps improvement on the 16-GPU pool and the ops team is confident they can consume the extra throughput if we secure capacity for Q3.

We need: an amendment to our current reserved pool to double from 8 → 16 GPUs, updated monthly commit, and a short SLO addendum for throughput guarantees (99th pct token latency target). Can you send a proposal with pricing, activation timeline, and any required SOW language? Procurement wants an initial cost estimate by next Friday.

Appreciate it — Samira
Samira Khan
Head of ML Ops, Orchid Analytics

Attachments: none

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@orchid.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Need to scale reserved pool for Q3 — 8→16 GPUs

Samira —

Great news on the POC results. We can do this. I pulled together the ops and finance teams to scope a clean amendment: pricing delta for the additional 8 GPUs, a staged activation plan, and the SLO clause you requested.

High-level answers now:
- Activation window: 2–3 business days once the amendment is countersigned (we can phase capacity over 48 hours to avoid cold-cache effects).
- Monthly commit: we show two options — fixed 16-GPU monthly commit vs. phased ramp (first 30 days billed at 12 GPUs effective, then full 16).
- Throughput SLO: we can add a throughput guardrail tied to observed 95/99th token latency with a credit mechanism (standard SLO-credit template).

I'll follow up with a formal PDF proposal and SOW draft by Thursday EOD. Laura / Marissa — looping you for pricing and legal checks.

Thanks,
Jonas
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: none

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 11:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reserved pool scale — pricing scenarios

Quick note on numbers:
- Option A (Immediate full commit): +8 GPUs at $32k/mo incremental (quantized profile q4) — total monthly commit for 16 GPUs: $98k/mo.
- Option B (Phased ramp): Month 1 bill at 12 GPUs ($74k), Month 2+ at 16 GPUs ($98k); we can offer a 6% term discount if they sign a 12-month amendment.
- SLO credit: 5% of monthly invoice per qualifying breach, capped at 15%/quarter.

I attached a clean proposal PDF and SOW draft with the activation timeline and billing examples. Please confirm the SOW language around data separation (they want VPC private flows for inference telemetry).

-Marissa
Senior Sales Ops, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Orchid_16GPU_Proposal_v3.pdf, SOW_Draft_Orchid.docx

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 08:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reserved pool scale — legal & billing notes

TL;DR: proposal looks good with two edits: (1) tighten the SLO credit trigger to confirm synthetic benchmark window (we should reference the POC test harness id), and (2) add a clause allowing Orchid to request a one-time credit review if usage dips below 70% of committed for two consecutive months.

Also confirm that the billing proration is pro-rated to the day of activation — finance prefers explicit examples in the amendment. I've redlined the SOW with both items (see SOW_Draft_Orchid.docx).

-LB

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@orchid.ai>
Cc: procurement@orchid.ai, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Apr 2027 16:09:00 -0700
Subject: Orchid Analytics — 16 GPU amendment (proposal attached)

Samira —

Attached is the formal amendment package we discussed: Orchid_16GPU_Proposal_v3.pdf (pricing scenarios, activation timeline, example invoices) and SOW_Draft_Orchid.docx with the SLO and proration redlines Laura suggested. Highlights:
- Option A (Immediate): effective start date on countersign, full 16-GPU billing $98k/month.
- Option B (Phased): 30-day ramp at 12 GPUs ($74k) then full 16 GPUs; recommended if Orchid wants lower near-term cashflow.
- SLOs: 95/99 token latency targets with crediting mechanics; references POC harness ID: POC-ORCH-202703.
- Activation: 48–72 hours after countersign; engineering runbook attached in SOW.

Next steps: please confirm preferred option and I will generate the amendment and DocuSign. Procurement, let us know any PO requirements.

Thanks — Jonas
